about_the_game:
This official soundtrack from Ghost Traveler: Adventures in Edo features the main theme “Yoshiwara Hanauta” — a single lyrical piece that captures the fleeting sorrow and fragile beauty of Yoshiwara’s courtesan world.『Ghost Traveler: Adventures in Edo』

Song Title: Yoshiwara Hanauta

Vocals: Kaon Kokudo

Composition & Arrangement: Kenichi Arakawa

Guitar: Hiroyuki Taneda

Bass: Shinji Hasuike

Shakuhachi: Tadahiro Nitta

Length: 5:11 

*Features both vocal and instrumental versions.

ーーーーー

This soundtrack does not use AI-generated music or audio. However, some promotional images, such as capsule artwork, were created with the help of AI-based design tools.
